properties.selection_rationale: A bounded high-altitude arid terrain window near the existing Upper Mustang research locator; selected for repeatable terrain screening, not as a claim about the whole region.
known_limitations: The AOI requires expert review and field-context validation
Terrain does not measure aridity, geology, access, or operational safety
properties.creation_method: Approximate WGS84 display footprint around a 10 km metric analysis grid center.
properties.planetary_target: The registered 10 km Jezero reference window under terrain-only comparison.
properties.representativeness: Feature-focused window; it does not represent the complete Upper Mustang region.
properties.known_selection_bias: The site was selected as an established project candidate before terrain-v3 scoring; independent AOI review is pending.
